en: Angel, got a second?{wait}{clear}＜妖精名＞ looks really tired. Why not let them rest once in a while?
Angel, there's a hero who wants to meet with you.{wait}{clear}Will you see ＜勇者名＞?
All right, I'll pass that along.
Angel, there are heroes who want to meet with you.{wait}{clear}Who will you see, ＜勇者名１＞ or ＜勇者名２＞?
Angel, a report.{wait}{clear}＜勇者名＞'s level has gone up.
Angel, a report.{wait}{clear}＜勇者名＞'s level has gone up by ○○.
Then let's hurry, Angel! And back ＜勇者名＞ up in the fight!
Is that so? Then we can't back them up in the fight, but let's at least go have a look!
Angel! ＜勇者名＞ has run into the enemy!{wait}{clear}We can't back them up in battle, but let's at least go see how ＜勇者名＞ is doing!
It's bad! Looks like ＜勇者名＞ got badly hurt in battle.{wait}{clear}Go to ＜勇者名＞.{wait}{clear}And when you get there, give them a healing item, or go with them and give your blessing.
Angel, are you sure you don't want to go to ＜勇者名＞? They're badly hurt.{wait}{clear}Hurry and give them a healing item, or go with them and give your blessing.
It's bad, Angel! ＜勇者名＞ has gone missing.{wait}{clear}Looks like something was bugging them... Angel, what do we do?
Angel, it's been a good while since ＜勇者名＞ went missing. Are you okay leaving it like this?
Looks like ＜勇者名＞ failed to resolve ＜イベント名＞.
Angel, the incident's disappeared.{wait}{clear}Looks like ＜イベント名＞ in ＜地方名＞ is gone.{wait}{clear}And ＜勇者名＞, who was heading there, didn't make it in time.
Angel, a report.{wait}{clear}I searched ＜地方名＞, but there was nothing out of the ordinary.
Angel, a report.{wait}{clear}Your level's about to go up. When you go back to the Heavens, you should go see Lord Raphael.
Angel, I found a hero candidate!

In Sayak, Celesta, in the Six Kingdoms Alliance, I found a young Warlock.{wait}{clear}His name's Fein Lu Lugus.{wait}{clear}He travels around taking all sorts of jobs for the Guild of mages.{wait}{clear}He's also got a huge store of knowledge, and he really knows his stuff about Arcaya's history and magic.{wait}{clear}I think he'd make a good ally for you, Angel. Why not go and meet him?

In Leszno, Slatina, in the Duchy of Courrege, I found a young man named Clive Saingrent.{wait}{clear}He's a vampire hunter who specializes in slaying undead, mostly for towns and villages on the frontier.{wait}{clear}Maybe it's his line of work, but seeing him only ever active at night, I can't shake the feeling he's not quite human...{wait}{clear}Still, his sword skill was something else. So I think you really should meet him. What do you say, Angel?

In Fanlan, the capital of the Kingdom of Legrance, in Ellora, I found a hero candidate.{wait}{clear}His name's Rudiere Trier Legrance. He's the second prince of Legrance.{wait}{clear}But he hardly has anything to do with running the country, and he seems to just play around every day. I get the feeling there's some reason for it, though...{wait}{clear}He's really curious, and I can feel he's got more drive than anyone.{wait}{clear}I think he'd be a help to you, Angel. Why not go and meet him?

In Araras, the capital of the Holy Nation of Ecclesia, in Linares, I found a young clergyman named Rocus Las Flores.{wait}{clear}He has a mysterious power, and I heard rumors he's really supposed to become Pope. But the way he lives now makes me wonder...{wait}{clear}N-no, never mind. Anyway, he's a clergyman, so why not go and meet him once?

In Darg on Bremes Isle, I found a young mage girl named Irene Tirnag.{wait}{clear}She lives in a tower with an owl, and works hard every day in her pursuit of magical knowledge.{wait}{clear}I can feel her magic is huge and strong, so if she becomes a hero, I'm sure she'll do great things. Why not go and meet her first?

In Reizefut, the capital of the Grosain Empire, in Reizefut, I found a woman who's an imperial knight.{wait}{clear}Her name's Leyla Vigrid. She's got superb swordsmanship and a strong sense of justice, and they say she's the first woman ever to become a knight.{wait}{clear}But it looks like she got caught up in some trouble, and she's in prison right now.{wait}{clear}Looks like she was locked up for a crime she didn't commit at all, so won't you help her out, Angel?

In Leiria, Fes, in the untamed lands, I found a girl who handles a bow with real skill.{wait}{clear}Her name's Cecia. She's a daughter of the clan that lives in the Reyforia Forest, which spreads across the untamed lands.{wait}{clear}I couldn't learn the details, but from a legend passed down in her clan, she seems to admire angels.{wait}{clear}So I'm sure she'll gladly help you, Angel. Why not go and meet her?

Angel, Leyla Vigrid, the hero candidate we found, has gone missing.{wait}{clear}Looks like it's because her mother in Reizefut, the Empire's capital, passed away. We have no idea at all where Leyla-sama went...{wait}{clear}It's a real shame, but one of Arcaya's hopes has been lost.
Angel, the Empire's invasion has begun in earnest.{wait}{clear}I think it'll affect lots of countries and regions of the world. Keep a close eye on changes in the chaos level.

Angel! The Empire has started invading toward the heart of the Six Kingdoms.{wait}{clear}Besides the Six Kingdoms, the frontier and other countries bordering the Empire are being invaded one after another.{wait}{clear}Please be careful, the heroes and you too, Angel.

Angel! The Empire invaded Alkmaar in Basel and destroyed the Grand Lodge, the heart of the Guild.{wait}{clear}I think this'll have a really serious effect on every country.{wait}{clear}And it looks like something really important has fallen into the Empire's hands.{wait}{clear}Stopping the Empire's invasion might be tough even for the heroes, but watch out the chaos level doesn't go up.

Angel! St. Diana, the Holy Mother of the Reyforia Forest, was attacked by a boy with a magical beast.{wait}{clear}And it looks like Cecia-sama, who's also one of your heroes, will carry on her wishes and become the Holy Mother.

Angel...! The heroes fought hard, but... the capital of the Holy Nation of Ecclesia has fallen to the Empire.{wait}{clear}The city was torn to pieces, and the cathedral got burned too...{wait}{clear}Lots of people died, but it looks like some managed to escape.{wait}{clear}Angel, I'm really worried about what'll happen to Arcaya from here... Be really careful too, Angel.
Angel...! Hugues Zeint, the king of the Kingdom of Legrance, has passed away.{wait}{clear}It's only a rumor, but they say somebody assassinated him.

Angel! The Empire has invaded all the way to Legrance.{wait}{clear}And there seem to be demons in the imperial army, so they must be using the Demon Stone's power.{wait}{clear}I know the fighting's tough, but hang in there somehow, Angel. I'll do my part too!
Angel! Ion, the boy who stole the Demon Stone from the Forest of the Holy Mother, has died.{wait}{clear}Looks like Serenis, the Empire's witch, was using the strong magic power he had.

Angel!! The Heavenly Dragon has finally been revived.{wait}{clear}The Heavenly Dragon is the incarnation of Satan's soul. It'll swallow up towns and people one after another...{wait}{clear}The end of the world is only a matter of time. Angel, join forces with the heroes and protect Arcaya!

Angel! A hero defeated Clarence, the one called Viper, who stole the Demon Stone from the Holy Nation of Ecclesia.{wait}{clear}Looks like he couldn't hold any hope for this world, so he sided with the Empire of his own accord...
Angel! A hero defeated Ravenruft, the vampire king.{wait}{clear}Now I think people on the frontier will hardly ever get attacked by the undead!

Angel! A man named Fein Lu Lugus of Celesta in the Six Kingdoms Alliance seemed promising as a hero candidate...{wait}{clear}But his life was taken by mysterious mages.{wait}{clear}It's really sad, but one of Arcaya's hopes has been lost.
